source: Facebook page (98% recommend, 37 reviews) + Instagram student posts on @siargao.maximumfreediving, read 2026-09-19. Quoted as written; newest first. Facebook shows one review without login – add more from the page when logged in.

reviews.name: Student
reviews.text: Freediving in Siargao was definitely one for the bucket list. There’s something so surreal about taking that first breath, going beneath the surface, and leaving everything else behind. It taught me to be present, focus on every breath, and find comfort in staying calm while surrounded by nothing but deep blue. Big thanks to coach Nate for guiding me and making the whole experience so memorable!

reviews.name: Student
reviews.text: Only video I got because my body wasn’t quite conditioned for it yet. Still, Daku Cave was worth every breath.

reviews.name: Returning student
reviews.text: Back home. Thank you Nate for capturing me in my favourite playground – this was some of the most fun I’ve had all year.
